Reda 400-series low-rate pump; hp/stage anchored to Brown Vol. 2b Ex. #3B (real book source); flow range comparable to real Reda D460N (200-650 bpd, SLB/Reda catalog). Off-BEP: std centrifugal.

Reda GN-series (540). Flow range real (Reda GN4000: 3200-4800 bpd, Pengtools/SLB catalog). BEP head/eff anchored to real Reda GN5200 catalog BEP (28.34 ft/stage, 66.1% — same 540 series). Off-BEP: std centrifugal shape.

Reda GN-series (540). Flow range real (Reda GN5600: 4000-7500 bpd, Pengtools/SLB catalog). BEP head/eff anchored to real Reda GN5200 catalog BEP (28.34 ft/stage, 66.1% — sister 540-series model). Off-BEP: std centrifugal shape.

Centrilift 513 mixed-flow; BEP flow 6100 bpd REAL (TUALP / Pessoa-Prado experimental pump). BEP head/eff approximated from real Reda D5800N catalog BEP (22.63 ft/stage, 70% — nearest high-rate anchor, cross-manufacturer). Off-BEP: std centrifugal shape.

Weatherford ESP mapped to real Reda 400-series equivalent (user-authorized). Flow range from real Reda D1400N (960-1700 bpd). BEP head/eff anchored to real Reda D1150N catalog BEP (36.87 ft/stage, 61.0%). Off-BEP: std centrifugal shape.

Weatherford ESP mapped to real Reda D2400N (user-authorized; near-exact rate match). Flow range, BEP head & efficiency all from real Reda D2400N catalog (1500-3200 bpd, BEP 2396 bpd, 25.27 ft/stage, 68.9%). Off-BEP: std centrifugal shape.

Weatherford ESP mapped to real Reda D5800N (user-authorized). Flow range, BEP head & efficiency from real Reda D5800N catalog (4400-7000 bpd, BEP 5820 bpd, 22.63 ft/stage, 70.2%). Off-BEP: std centrifugal shape.

SLB High Rise (400). Flow range real (SLB data sheet). BEP head/eff anchored to nearest real Reda N-series by rate — D1150N (36.87 ft/stage, 61.0%). HighRise curves not public; approximation. Off-BEP: std centrifugal shape.

SLB High Rise (400). Flow range real (SLB data sheet). BEP head/eff anchored to nearest real Reda N-series by rate — D1150N (36.87 ft/stage, 61.0%). HighRise curves not public; approximation. Off-BEP: std centrifugal shape.

SLB High Rise (400). Flow range real (SLB data sheet). BEP head/eff anchored to nearest real Reda N-series by rate — D1150N (36.87 ft/stage, 61.0%). HighRise curves not public; approximation. Off-BEP: std centrifugal shape.

SLB High Rise (513). Flow range real (SLB data sheet). BEP head/eff anchored to nearest real Reda N-series by rate — D2400N (25.27 ft/stage, 68.9%). HighRise curves not public; approximation. Off-BEP: std centrifugal shape.

SLB High Rise (538). Flow range real (SLB data sheet). BEP head/eff anchored to nearest real Reda N-series by rate — D4300N (21.34 ft/stage, 70.3%). HighRise curves not public; approximation. Off-BEP: std centrifugal shape.

SLB High Rise (538). Flow range real (SLB data sheet). BEP head/eff anchored to nearest real Reda 540-series by rate — GN5200 (28.34 ft/stage, 66.1%). HighRise curves not public; approximation. Off-BEP: std centrifugal shape.

_note: Two data classes: (1) pumps digitized from Kermit Brown Vol. 2b Ch. 4.5 examples; (2) pumps generated by scripts/generate_pump_curves.py (marked with _source). For class (2) the BEP anchor (head/eff) and flow range are taken from REAL catalog data where available (Reda D-series & GN5200 BEP; SLB/Pengtools flow ranges) — see each _source and CORRECCION_CATALOGOS.md; only the BEP point is real, off-BEP points follow the standard centrifugal shape with HP derived from hydraulic horsepower. Not a substitute for the manufacturer's measured curve.
